ops.text: (v) upon expiry or termination, at Customer's request, Kubient shall provide transition assistance for up to 6 months at Kubient's then-current rates; (vi) Kubient shall return Customer Data to Customer in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, including all Content, Requests and other data of or relating to Customer then in Kubient's possession or control; and (vii) after such return, Kubient shall delete such Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit to section 4(c): up to 6 months' transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion after return. Section 4(c) currently only stops the Services, leaving no route to recover or migrate our data; we can accept 90 days' assistance if 6 months is not workable.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion into section 4(c)
